data.name: Izaz
data.gender_notes: Izaz is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘izzah’ meaning 'might, power, and strength'. In Islamic history, Izaz refers to Allah's names associated with might and power. The name Izaz carries the meaning “Mighty, Powerful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Izaz usually hope their child will grow to embody mighty, powerful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of Allah's power and strength.
data.etymology: Izaz belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mighty, Powerful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Izaz total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: عزاز
in_arabic.long_meaning: يعني اسم عزاز الشخص الذي يتمتع بالعزة والكرامة والقوة، ويعود أصل هذا الاسم إلى الجذر العربي عزز، الذي يشير إلى الفخر والاعتزاز بالشخص أو الشيء، ولهذا الاسم أهمية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية حيث يشير إلى الشخص الذي يتمتع بالكرامة والاحترام

in_urdu.name: عزاز
in_urdu.long_meaning: عزاز نام کا مطلب ہے عزت و کرامت والا شخص، اور اس کا اصل عربي زبان سے لیا گیا ہے، جہاں یہ عزز سے ماخوذ ہے، جو فخر و ناز کے معنی میں آتا ہے، اور یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں بہت اہم ہے کیونکہ یہ شخص کی عزت و کرامت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

This connection highlights the notion that power and strength come from Allah, and that those who believe in Him can also draw upon His power and strength in their own lives.
